description: This file contains an extension for the OnboardingView class, implementing various user interface actions related to onboarding and gateway selection, including navigation, settings, and clipboard copying.

methods.name: selectLocalGateway
methods.description: Sets the connection mode to local, clears preferred gateway ID, disables advanced connection, and updates preferences.

methods.name: selectUnconfiguredGateway
methods.description: Sets the connection mode to unconfigured, cancels onboarding if running, clears preferred gateway ID, disables advanced connection, and updates preferences.

methods.name: selectRemoteGateway
methods.description: Sets up remote gateway connection by storing the gateway's stable ID, applying remote selection support, and updating shared gateway coordinator.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Opens the specified settings tab, triggers the routing, and posts a notification to select the tab.

methods.name: handleBack
methods.description: Navigates back a page in the onboarding flow with animation.

methods.name: handleNext
methods.description: Advances to the next onboarding page, or finishes the onboarding if on the last page.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Marks onboarding as seen in UserDefaults and closes the onboarding controller.

methods.name: copyToPasteboard
methods.description: Copies provided text to system clipboard and temporarily indicates success.
